response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds) AS avg_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), a AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_rate FROM m) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.avg_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.avg_rate - a.overall_rate) AS avg_excess FROM m CROSS JOIN a WHERE m.avg_rate > a.overall_rate

assumptions.assumption: Average unit price per media type uses all tracks, including those with NULL Bytes; only the byte-rate average excludes tracks with no size.

Byte rate is computed as Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds to avoid integer division. Media types with no tracks that have Bytes have a NULL rate and are left out of the cross-media-type average and the filter.
